thread.title: Technology Sector Update for 09/05/2018: JNPR, CIEN, COUP, WDAY, UTX

author: MT Newswires
title: Technology Sector Update for 09/05/2018: JNPR, CIEN, COUP, WDAY, UTX
text:
Shutterstock photo Top Technology Stocks:
MSFT: -0.3%
AAPL: -0.2%
IBM: -0.4%
CSCO: flat
GOOGL: flat
Technology shares were mostly lower in pre-market trading on Wednesday.
Expected movers:
- Coupa Software ( COUP ) swung to profit in Q2, and issued Q3 guidance above Street view
- United Technologies ( UTX ) reiterated its 2018 expectations ahead of meeting with investors
- Workday ( WDAY ) reported fiscal Q2 results that topped Wall Street expectations
Other news:
- Juniper Networks ( JNPR ) expanded 18-year partnership with Ericsson ( ERIC ) to develop an end-to-end 5G solution leveraging each company's complementary portfolios
- Ciena (CIEN) agreed to acquire privately held DonRiver
